card.name: Warnings in see-section cross-references
card.fires_on: The word Warnings (or WARNINGS) after "[see W" or "[see WARN" in label cross-references. It fires on the final piece of the word, just before "and Precautions" and a section number.

modes.label: Mixed-case Warnings
modes.description: The ending of "Warnings" after "[see W" in a cross-reference to Warnings and Precautions.

modes.label: Capitalized WARNINGS
modes.description: The ending of all-caps "WARNINGS" in the same kind of cross-reference.

card.writes: It seems to suppress name-like tokens, which fits a word that is already complete and is followed by "and Precautions".
card.plain: It marks the end of the word Warnings inside a "[see Warnings and Precautions]" pointer to another label section.
